results.title: NeuroHua Safety Helmets Track Workers’ Brainwaves and Raise Privacy Concerns - DongA Science
results.snippet: According to a report by the international journal 'Science' on the 5th (local time), devices that use brainwaves to detect fatigue are spreading across high-risk workplaces in China, such as construction sites, mines, and steel mills.
